grammarFocus: 因果关系、条件和对比；段落间逻辑与指代。
title: Timed Writing: Causes, Solutions and Two-Sided Discussion
prompt: In many cities, people increasingly choose to live alone rather than with family members or housemates. Some observers believe this trend reflects greater personal freedom and improved living standards, while others argue that it weakens community ties and increases social isolation. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. In your discussion, explain at least one cause of this trend and propose one practical measure that could help reduce any negative effects you identify. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为限时写作练习（建议40分钟）。请先花约5分钟审题并列出双方观点、一个原因和一项措施，再用约30分钟完成不少于250词的完整文章，最后留约5分钟检查。注意：题目要求你讨论双方观点、给出自己的立场、解释该趋势的一个原因，并提出一项可减少负面影响的可行措施，四项内容都要覆盖。所有情境与数据均为模拟练习材料，并非官方雅思试题。写作时请用自己的观点和例子展开论证，不要只罗列要点。
